name: Tinted icons
description: Adds a Monochrome Tint switch under Theme > Tint Icons: tinted app icons in the tray, dock, workspaces and launcher are drawn in one theme colour while keeping their own shading, and the active workspace and selected launcher entry swap to the primary colour. Off by default; the stock palette tint is unchanged.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Adds the theme.monochromeTint key to theme.json
Changes how app icons are rendered in the bar, dock and launcher when the switch is on
